question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
actual_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_active_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eur_customers,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS eur_customer_pct
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_id
  FROM transactions_1k t
  WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-25'
) active
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_id = active.customer_id
expected_response: {"gold_sql": "SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-25'"}
